_spec.purpose: The case register. Every RUN takes the next case number, pass or fail, and it is never reused and never skipped. A gap in the numbering would be the show lying about its own record. Phase 0 reads next_case, Phase 7 (or the kill path) appends the entry.
_spec.brand_rule: Case numbers are the show's archive spine. CASE No. 0400 implies 399 before it and implies somebody kept them. See knowledge/BRAND_BIBLE.md.

entry_schema.title: the angle as a title, or null if killed

entries.title: CASE No. 0001 - The Pricing Update With No Pricing In It
entries.killed_reason: Run incomplete, not a quality failure. Script, claims, composition and brand all cleared their gates and render correctly, but there is no VO (the voice stack needs .venv-voice, and it speaks one voice for three characters) so no audio, no aligned captions and no final mp4. The case number is consumed regardless, per the never-skip rule.
